title: Bootstrap Nx Angular Domain Platform
body:
As a platform builder, I want to initialize a clean Nx monorepo so that I can build reusable Angular libraries and applications.

Tasks:
- Initialize Nx workspace
- Configure Angular standalone
- Setup Rspack & Vitest

Acceptance Criteria:
Given a fresh clone
When I run nx serve
Then the app starts successfully

title: Define core-config library
body:
As an application developer, I want a core-config library so that configuration can be injected consistently across applications.

Tasks:
- Create core-config library
- Define config token
- Implement ConfigService
- Unit tests

Acceptance Criteria:
Given an app
When I inject config
Then I can read typed configuration

title: Implement core-http library
body:
As a developer, I want a reusable HTTP abstraction so that all apps share the same HTTP behavior.

Tasks:
- Create core-http library
- HttpService wrapper
- Unit tests

Acceptance Criteria:
Given an HTTP call
When I use CoreHttpService
Then the request is executed correctly

title: Add HTTP interceptor with config token
body:
As a developer, I want an HTTP interceptor so that base URLs and headers are centralized.

Tasks:
- Create HTTP interceptor
- Handle relative vs absolute URLs
- Inject CORE_HTTP_CONFIG
- Unit tests

Acceptance Criteria:
Given a relative URL
When the request is sent
Then baseUrl is applied

title: Setup GitHub CI pipeline
body:
As a maintainer, I want CI pipelines so that every push is validated automatically.

Tasks:
- Configure GitHub Actions
- Run lint, test, build, e2e

Acceptance Criteria:
Given a PR
When CI runs
Then all checks pass

title: Define OSS contribution standards
body:
As an OSS maintainer, I want contribution standards so that external contributors understand how to participate.

Tasks:
- README update
- Contribution guidelines
- Commit conventions

Acceptance Criteria:
Given a contributor
When they read the docs
Then they know how to contribute

title: Design domain-driven library structure
body:
As a platform architect, I want a domain-oriented structure so that libraries map business concepts.

Tasks:
- Define domain vs core libs
- Naming conventions

Acceptance Criteria:
Given a new domain
When a lib is created
Then it follows the standard

title: Implement core-logging library
body:
As a developer, I want structured logging so that applications are observable.

Tasks:
- Create core-logging lib
- Console + future extensibility
- Tests

Acceptance Criteria:
Given an event
When logged
Then format is consistent

title: Prepare npm publishing strategy
body:
As a maintainer, I want a versioning and publishing strategy so that libraries can be safely released.

Tasks:
- Define semantic versioning rules
- Tag strategy
- Draft GitHub Action

Acceptance Criteria:
Given a tag
When pushed
Then npm publish is triggered

title: LinkedIn automation after npm release
body:
As a freelance expert, I want to publish LinkedIn posts automatically so that releases increase visibility.

Tasks:
- Identify LinkedIn API / workaround
- Define post template

Acceptance Criteria:
Given a release
When pipeline finishes
Then a post is prepared
